_comment: TEMPORARY Day-6 volume prefilter for the Feashliaa feed. It only stops obviously irrelevant worldwide jobs from being stored. It is NOT the search profile and encodes no final role preferences; the real eight-category profile comes later. Seeded from the example role-type names in the implementation guide. Case-insensitive; each phrase must start at a word boundary (short phrases of 3 characters or fewer must also end at one). A job is kept if ANY phrase appears in its title.
